preventive_first.title: Prevention block
preventive_first.body: Choose one low-friction habit that reduces the chance of overload this week (earlier wind-down, hydration anchor, or a short daily walk).

physiological_first.title: Physiology block
physiological_first.body: Protect a consistent sleep window and add one recovery practice before adding intensity or new goals.

behavioral_first.title: Behavior block
behavioral_first.body: Define a clear cue and a 10-minute starter routine so the habit can survive busy days.

lifestyle.title: Lifestyle rhythm
lifestyle.body: Align meal timing, daylight exposure, and movement with the hours you feel most stable.

risk_awareness.title: Risk-aware check-in
risk_awareness.body: Note any new or worsening symptoms and bring them to a clinician if they persist; use Health Guide for educational framing only.

performance.title: Performance balance
performance.body: Match training or deep-work blocks with equal recovery blocks so progress stays sustainable.

questionnaire.title: Keep questionnaires current
questionnaire.body: Your questionnaire is {{percent}}% complete. Update sections when your state changes so future reports stay accurate.

service.title: Continue with {{service}}
service.body: Return to the {{service}} workspace after trying one recommendation and capture what changed.

devices.title: Optional device layer
devices.body: Link a wearable when ready so trends can complement questionnaire context.

devicesActive.title: Review device trends
devicesActive.body: Skim the last week from your {{count}} linked device(s) and note one pattern that matches how you felt.
